claims.value: 6 deposited RAW ZIP archives: cytoplasmic, endosomal, and plasma-membrane fractions in two replicates.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol and exact fraction/replicate tokens in deposited archive names.

limitations: Each deposited archive contains ten gel-slice RAW files, but only the archive is exposed as a PRIDE RAW entry; the SDRF therefore has one row per archive.
